alate: Dorsum of the vertex and the dorsum of the thorax and abdomen yellowish brown, the ventral surface of the head and the legs yellow, the venter of the abdomen yellowish brown, the wings pale brown. Ocelli oval, their distance from the compound eye slightly less than the length of the ocellus and greater than its width; the vertex flat, the fontanelle a small conical projection. Antennae with 19 segments, segments 3 to 7 about equal in length and all shorter than segment 2, the terminal segment longer than segment 2. The anterior and the posterior margin of the pronotum each with a slight median notch; the middle of the pronotum bears a pale cross-shaped mark with a small pale spot on each side in front of it.
biology: The nest is generally built in the soil beneath the turf and is subterranean, occasionally found in earthen walls beside a stove; the nest may stand partly above ground and consists of many scattered fungus-garden chambers and fungus gardens; the species can bore into the trunks of trees and into the ground-level parts of wooden posts.
distribution: Mojiang (1,400 m a.s.l.), Pu'er (1,350 m a.s.l.), Yunjinghong (500 m a.s.l.), Mengla in Jinping (350 m a.s.l.) and Lianshan, Yunnan; abroad it is found in Myanmar.
soldier: Head deep yellow, the base of the mandibles brownish and the anterior part black, the thorax pale yellow, the abdomen nearly white; setae on the head extremely sparse, the thorax and abdomen with hairs of unequal length. Head large and flat, oval in dorsal view, narrow anteriorly and broad posteriorly, the lateral and posterior margins slightly arched; the postmentum does not bulge strongly from the ventral surface of the head and is narrow only at the anterior end, its remaining part almost equal in width. Mandibles robust; the left mandible has a sharp tooth behind the midpoint, its apex directed obliquely forwards; the right mandible has a granular tooth-like projection at the corresponding position. The lateral margins of the labrum are arcuate and the anterior end is contracted, reaching the middle of the mandibles. Antennae with 17 segments, segments 2 and 4 about equal in length, segment 3 slightly shorter. Both the anterior and the posterior margin of the pronotum have a median notch.
worker: Head deep yellow, thorax and abdomen pale yellow. Head squarish and flattened, antennae with 19 segments, segment 2 longer than segment 3; the anterior and the posterior margin of the pronotum slightly concave at the middle. Length of head to the apex of the labrum 2.22–2.72 mm, width of head 1.75–1.94 mm.
